title: Static Raised-Ladder Fire Truck
description: Original complete static raised-ladder fire vehicle appearance: a new short cab and shuttered equipment body on a three-axle chassis, four deployed ground-pad outriggers, fixed rear turntable and twin nested open rung ladders on a cross pivot. All geometry is newly constructed, no old vehicle or ladder is imported. Opaque window and lamp surfaces. Fixed visual pose only, not a working vehicle: no driving, steering, rescue, telescoping, rotation, hydraulic operation, human fit, load capacity, stability or safety performance is claimed.
